mapper.select: SELECT b.booth_id , b.business_id , a.fair_id FROM booth b JOIN application a ON a.application_id = b.application_id JOIN business bu ON bu.business_id = b.business_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = bu.owner_id WHERE b.booth_id = #{boothId} AND u.user_id = #{vendorUserId} AND u.role = 'VENDOR' AND u.status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT booth_visit_id , visit_count , first_visited_at FROM booth_visits WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId} AND booth_id = #{boothId} FOR UPDATE
